system.description: As part of casting a Hanami Clan Hijutsu that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane and any creature that fails their save, becomes Confused for the next minute. If the chosen jutsu allows the affected creature to remake their saving throw, they end this effect on a success. If the chosen jutsu does not allow a resave, then the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.
